# MINA — Detailed Analysis — 5dd

## Summary

Financial claims and recommendations below are attributed to this September 25, 2026 report and its supplied September 24 technical snapshot. They are preserved historical claims, forecasts and conditions, not current market facts.[^mina-b3a41fc7cf56b70d]

The report rates MINA Neutral/Wait with low-to-moderate confidence at IDR 232. RSI 28.7923, short RSI 18.7697, oversold channels and extreme negative z-scores support rebound potential. Aroon oscillator −92, bearish SuperTrend/Vortex/MACD/Fisher, negative EMA positioning and uniformly negative momentum oppose reversal. Volume Ratio 20D 0.5084, CMF −0.2663, and falling OBV/ADL/MFI show weak demand.[^mina-b3a41fc7cf56b70d]

Session-5 scenarios are bull IDR 244–250 at 25%, base IDR 228–238 at 45%, and bear IDR 218–228 at 30%. Its representative gross expected return is about +0.65%, with weighted endpoints −1.29% to +2.59%. These judgmental scenarios exclude costs, dividends and gaps; their small positive expectation is insufficient in the report’s view to compensate for execution uncertainty.[^mina-b3a41fc7cf56b70d]

The report describes slow rights-issue proceeds deployment, the Sanur development plan and supportive but mixed Bali tourism data as background. It flags historical 2025 UMA/suspensions without alleging current manipulation. No company catalyst is confirmed in the five-session window. BI/global tightening is an indirect headwind; turnover value, order-book depth and current foreign flow are missing.[^mina-b3a41fc7cf56b70d]

Its IDR 230–234 watch area requires visible reversal and improved participation; stronger confirmation is a completed close above 242. A close below 230 invalidates the thesis. IDR 218 is a deeper ATR-derived risk reference rather than guaranteed tactical execution. Profit zone is 244–250; a second zone is unavailable. The illustrative 232/218/247 structure yields only 1.07:1 gross reward-to-risk.[^mina-b3a41fc7cf56b70d]

The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to currency stabilization, with restrictive financing and risk appetite partly offset by reduced market stress. Its September 16 Fed-increase news is an indirect capital-flow and property-equity headwind rather than a direct MINA earnings calculation.[^mina-b3a41fc7cf56b70d]
